blocks.text: Zyada tar khasiyatein mukhtalif genes ke aapas ke amal (interaction) se banti hain. Allelic interactions mein aik hi gene ke alleles aapas mein amal karte hain, jaise incomplete dominance, co-dominance aur multiple alleles. Non-allelic interactions mein mukhtalif genes ke alleles, mukhtalif loci par, aapas mein amal karte hain; aam misaal epistasis hai.

blocks.title: Epistasis
blocks.text: Epistasis genes ka aisa amal hai jis mein aik allele doosre loci par doosre genes ke alleles ka asar chhupata ya badalta hai. Chhupane ya badalne wala allele epistatic aur jis ka asar chhupta ya badalta hai woh hypostatic kehlata hai.
Kitab ganj-pan (baldness) ke allele ko kaale aur sunehre baalon ke alleles par epistatic batati hai. (Topic 18.8.3 mein ganj-pan ko sex-influenced khasiyat ke taur par dobara bayan kiya gaya hai.)

items: Gene B rang tay karta hai: B kaala aur b bhoora, is liye BB ya Bb kaala aur bb bhoora.

Gene E baalon mein rang ke jama hone ko qaboo karta hai: E ijazat deta, jab ke e (ee ki soorat mein) B aur b par epistatic hai aur ise rokta hai, is liye EE ya Ee kutton ke baal rangeen lekin ee kutte peele hote hain chahe B ho ya b.

blocks.text: Jab do heterozygous kaale kutte (BbEe x BbEe) milaye jayen to bachche kaale, bhoore aur peele 9:3:4 nisbat mein hote hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: kaala, bhoora aur peela Labrador aur un ke genotypes: kaala BBEE, BBEe, BbEE ya BbEe; bhoora bbEE ya bbEe; peela BBee, Bbee ya bbee. Neeche: do kaale BbEe kutton ka cross; 4 x 4 grid (oopar sperm BE, Be, bE, be, baen eggs) har bachche ka genotype aur rang deta hai: 9 kaale, 3 bhoore, 4 peele.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.8: Labrador ke baalon ke rang ke genotypes aur phenotypes (kitab ki Figure 18.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Grid ki qataarein (eggs) BE, Be, bE, be; har khane mein genotype aur Black, Brown ya Yellow likha hai.

blocks.text: ABO genotypes ka zahir hona aik aur gene, H, par bhi munhasir hai jo H substance banata hai, jo A aur B antigens ka pehla maadda (precursor) hai; IA aur IB aise enzymes banate hain jo H substance ko antigen-A aur antigen-B mein badalte hain. IA aur IB rakhne wala lekin hh genotype ka shakhs H substance nahi banata, is liye A ya B antigen nahi banta aur us ka phenotype O hota hai. Yeh Bombay phenotype 1952 mein Bombay mein daryaft hua aur zyada tar India, Bangladesh, Pakistan aur Iran mein milta hai.

items: Gene D: dominant D gehri surkh pattiyan aur recessive d halki surkh banata hai, is liye DD ya Dd gehra surkh aur dd halka surkh.
Gene W, doosre locus par: dominant W D ya d ke banaye rang ko chhote dhabbon tak mehdood karta hai, is liye pattiyan bahar se safaid lagti hain; recessive w yaksan rang hone deta hai.

blocks.text: Heterozygous DdWw paude ke phool safaid hote hain kyunke W rang ko andar ki taraf chhote dhabbon tak mehdood rakhta hai. Agar ise khud-fertilize kiya jaye to safaid, gehre surkh aur halke surkh phool 12:3:1 nisbat mein aate hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: gehre surkh, halke surkh aur safaid foxglove ke phool aur un ke genotypes: gehra surkh DDww ya Ddww; halka surkh ddww; safaid DDWW, DDWw, DdWW, DdWw, ddWW ya ddWw. Neeche: do safaid DdWw paudon ka cross; 4 x 4 grid (oopar nar gametes DW, Dw, dW, dw, baen maada gametes) har bachche ka genotype aur rang deta hai: 12 safaid, 3 gehre surkh, 1 halka surkh.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.9: Foxglove ke phool ke rang ke genotypes aur phenotypes (kitab ki Figure 18.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Grid ki qataarein (female gametes) DW, Dw, dW, dw; har khane mein genotype aur White, Dark red ya Light red likha hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki legend mein safaid phool ke genotypes sirf 'DDWW or DdWW or DdWw' likhe hain, magar grid mein DDWw, ddWW aur ddWw bhi safaid hain. Asal qaida: jis paude mein kam az kam aik W ho woh safaid hai, chahe D ho ya d. Is liye hamare khaake mein safaid ke chhe genotypes likhe hain. Sirf ww mein rang zahir hota: D ke saath gehra surkh, dd ke saath halka surkh; is tarah 12 : 3 : 1.

blocks.prompt: BbEe x BbEe Labradors mein peele 16 mein se 4 kyun hain, 3 kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Har ee kutta peela hai: 3 B_ee aur 1 bbee = 4. 9:3:3:1 ki qismein B_ee aur bbee mil jati hain kyunke ee B aur b ko chhupata hai.

blocks.prompt: Bombay phenotype wala shakhs, test mein group O lekin genes IA IB, H gene par kya genotype rakhta hai?
blocks.explanation: hh: H substance nahi banta, is liye IA aur IB ke enzymes ke paas A ya B antigens banane ke liye kuch nahi hota.

items: Epistasis: aik locus ka allele doosre locus ko chhupata ya badalta hai.
Labrador BbEe x BbEe: 9 kaale : 3 bhoore : 4 peele.
Foxglove DdWw khud-pollination: 12 safaid : 3 gehre surkh : 1 halka surkh.
Bombay phenotype: hh se O, ABO alleles kuch bhi hon.
